card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly the digit 6 in the estrogen dose 0.625 mg, and similar digits partway through a number before a unit. Also a few single words such as 'is' after 'behavior' in technical text.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd code-like word pieces and away from 'stack' words, so there is no meaningful output effect for dose text.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of dose numbers like 0.625 mg, mainly in estrogen trial text.
